photoProvenance: Existing restaurant gallery photographs come from the public TheFork restaurant listing and gallery. Generated illustrative food imagery includes rigatoni-feature.webp, hero-carbonara.webp, rigatoni-piece.webp, rigatoni-carbonara-piece.webp and the dish-specific files under public/images/dishes; prompts and local asset paths are in docs/generated-dish-images.json and docs/visual-motion.md. The Chef Kitchen portraits and food art are decorative template assets with MIT attribution. Provenance and the requested removal of inline notes are documented in docs/page-refinement.md.
